title: Elasticsearch Local-Cluster Exact-Total Search Closure
supportedOperation: A context-grounded local-cluster, non-scroll, non-search_after, non-early-terminated search with an exact total over at least one fully successful shard.
negativeProposition: The exact local-cluster Elasticsearch search has an accurate total hit count of zero over the declared and resolved nonempty shard set.
notes: timed_out, terminated_early, failed shards, gte totals, zero resolved shards, and unsupported request controls block a negative license.
Cardinality is derived from exact hits.total, not merely the returned page length.
Cross-cluster targets and responses containing _clusters are outside v0.3 because an unavailable optional remote cluster can be skipped while the request succeeds.
